rationale: The candidate is a coherent single stepped mass and reads consistently across views, so gesture and hierarchy are strong. The dominant idea is legible and the parcel response is acceptable: the mass sits within the green boundary rather than merely filling the frame. However, the access edge is underdeveloped: the blue frontage is answered only by a sealed-ish side condition and there is no convincing public court, seam, or undercut that would make the street threshold active. The silhouette is coherent but essentially a generic stepped extrusion, so it scores low on non-stair richness. Programmatically, the mass can plausibly support neighborhood living, but it is still closer to an abstract terraced object than a fully responsive active-edge building, hence only moderate program appropriateness and section fit.
